title: 8 Things a Godly Man Stops Snapping About at Home
caption:
Most guys flip it. Patient with coworkers, polite with strangers, and sharp with the people who love them most.

A godly man is hard on his own sin and gentle with his family. He catches the edge in his voice before it lands on his mom, his brother, or his dad.

Which one is yours? Be honest.

#faith #godlyman #family #gentleness #christianmen
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
